get.summary: Finds all provinces

parameters.name: _sort
parameters.description: With this param you can order your results. You can use all the fields of the item. For reverse order you must add a '-' simbol before the field. Example: _sort=label. You can combine more than one sort using ','. Example: _sort=label,-issued

parameters.name: _pageSize
parameters.description: With this param you can set the number of results for page. The max value is 200.

parameters.name: _page
parameters.description: The number of page that you want to see. The first page is 0.
